senses.en: covered with sand or containing a lot of sand
light yellowish brown in colour, especially describing hair

ex.en: We left our shoes beside the sandy path.
ex.zh: 我们把鞋放在了沙地小路旁。

ex.en: Sandy soils often require careful irrigation because they retain less water than soils with more clay.
ex.zh: 沙质土壤通常需要精心灌溉，因为其保水能力弱于黏土含量较高的土壤。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 3。sandy既可形容多沙的地面，也可形容浅黄褐色头发。

ex.en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
ex.zh: 图书馆允许访客一次借五本书。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。

col: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
allow enough time｜留出足够时间
allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

senses.zh: 错误的；失常的；不适当的
错误地；邪恶地，不正当地

ex.en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
ex.zh: 我坐错了公交车，结果到了机场附近。

ex.en: It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.
ex.zh: 仅仅因为家庭付不起学费就剥夺儿童受教育的机会，是不正当的。

col: something is wrong with｜……出了问题
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。go wrong表示出问题；wrong的词首w不发音。

senses.zh: 浏览；翻查；对…视而不见；看穿

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4

ex.en: Can you guess what is inside this little box?
ex.zh: 你能猜出这个小盒子里装着什么吗？

ex.en: Without reliable data, researchers can only guess how changes in transport costs will affect household spending.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的数据，研究人员只能猜测交通费用变化会如何影响家庭支出。

col: an educated guess｜有依据的猜测
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

ex.en: We got a good deal on our new sofa.
ex.zh: 我们以很划算的价格买到了新沙发。

ex.en: Governments must deal with housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
ex.zh: 政府必须通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。

col: deal with a problem｜处理问题
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。deal with表示处理；a great deal of后接不可数名词。

senses.zh: 表示不赞同或不以为然

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4

senses.zh: 作出；拟定；制定；计划一下

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4
📘 8B Unit 4

senses.zh: 关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系

ex.en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
ex.zh: 这个价格似乎与质量毫无关系。

ex.en: Researchers are examining the relation between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在考察城市社区中绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: relations between countries｜国家间的关系
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。

senses.zh: 通讯， 通信；交流；信函

ex.en: Clear communication helps us share the kitchen without arguments.
ex.zh: 清晰的沟通让我们共用厨房时不发生争执。

ex.en: Effective communication between healthcare professionals and patients can improve treatment outcomes and reduce misunderstandings.
ex.zh: 医护人员与患者之间的有效沟通可以改善治疗效果，减少误解。

col: a breakdown in communication｜沟通中断
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。表交流通常不可数；表一封正式函件可数。

ex.en: The children argued about whose turn it was to play.
ex.zh: 孩子们为轮到谁玩而争吵。

ex.en: Some researchers argue that affordable public transport is essential for reducing inequality in large cities.
ex.zh: 一些研究者认为，价格可负担的公共交通对于减少大城市中的不平等至关重要。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。

senses.zh: 云；阴云；云状物；一大群；黑斑
使混乱；以云遮敝；使忧郁；玷污

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

col: a cloud of dust｜一团尘土
cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

senses.zh: 年长的；年龄较大的；资格老的

ex.en: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Community elders can help preserve local traditions by sharing their knowledge and experiences with younger generations.
ex.zh: 社区长者可以通过向年轻一代分享知识和经历，帮助传承当地传统。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。elder 多放在亲属名词前；比较年龄用 older than。

ex.en: The café was closed, so we went home instead.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆关门了，于是我们改为回家。

ex.en: Instead of expanding roads, cities should invest in public transport to reduce congestion and pollution.
ex.zh: 城市应投资公共交通，而不是拓宽道路，以减少拥堵和污染。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。instead可单独作副词；instead of后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: You can choose whatever you like for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚餐你想吃什么都可以选。

ex.en: Whatever their background, students should have equal access to high-quality education and appropriate learning support.
ex.zh: 无论背景如何，学生都应平等地获得优质教育和适当的学习支持。

col: whatever the reason｜无论原因是什么
whatever you like｜任何你喜欢的东西
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。whatever不限范围；whichever常指限定范围内任选。

senses.zh: 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的

ex.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天第一次上游泳课前，我感到很紧张。

ex.en: Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.
ex.zh: 对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。

senses.zh: 提议；出价；意图；录取通知书

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to carry the heavy bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 邻居主动提出帮我们把沉重的袋子搬上楼。

ex.en: Universities should offer practical training that helps students develop skills relevant to the workplace.
ex.zh: 大学应提供实践培训，帮助学生培养与职场相关的技能。

col: offer someone a job｜给某人提供工作
make an offer｜出价；提出提议
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。

senses.zh: 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的

ex.en: You need proper shoes for walking on rocky paths.
ex.zh: 在碎石小路上走，你需要穿合适的鞋。

ex.en: Workers should receive proper training before operating machinery that could pose a risk to their safety.
ex.zh: 工人在操作可能危及自身安全的机器前，应接受适当培训。

col: a proper meal｜一顿像样的饭
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。表示“本身的”时放名词后，如the city proper。

ex.en: Firstly, the flat is affordable; secondly, it has a balcony.
ex.zh: 首先，这套公寓租金实惠；其次，它还有阳台。

ex.en: Secondly, expanding public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 其次，扩大公共交通覆盖范围可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地获得就业机会。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。

senses.zh: 通讯，传达；相通；交流；感染

ex.en: We communicate with our neighbours through a shared online group.
ex.zh: 我们通过一个共同的线上群组与邻居交流。

ex.en: Teachers need to communicate complex ideas clearly so that students with different abilities can understand them.
ex.zh: 教师需要清晰地传达复杂概念，让能力不同的学生都能理解。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。与某人交流用with；向某人传达某事用某事＋to。

ex.en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
ex.zh: 你能说明一下这台咖啡机怎么用吗？

ex.en: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
ex.zh: 医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。

col: explain something to someone｜向某人解释某事
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

senses.zh: 清楚的；清澈的；晴朗的；无罪的

ex.en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
ex.zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供明确的建议，让不同教育背景的人都能轻松理解。

col: crystal clear｜清澈透明的；非常清楚的
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。make it clear that…表示明确说明……。

ex.en: Please keep a copy of the receipt at home.
ex.zh: 请在家里留一份收据副本。

ex.en: Students should learn to evaluate sources rather than simply copy information from websites into their assignments.
ex.zh: 学生应学会评估资料来源，而不是直接把网站信息抄进作业。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。复数为copies；广告文案义的copy通常不可数。

ex.en: Please return these library books before you go away.
ex.zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。

col: return to work｜重返工作岗位
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

ex.en: I don't take the bus to school anymore.
ex.zh: 我不再坐公交车上学了。

ex.en: Many employees do not commute every day anymore because their employers now offer flexible working arrangements.
ex.zh: 许多员工不再每天通勤，因为雇主如今提供灵活的工作安排。

col: not live here anymore｜不再住在这里
not need it anymore｜不再需要它
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。表示“不再”；英式常写any more，数量“更多”须分写。

ex.en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
ex.zh: 每位俱乐部成员都带了一道菜与大家分享。

ex.en: Every member of a community can contribute to protecting local green spaces through regular volunteer work.
ex.zh: 社区中的每一位成员都可以通过定期参与志愿服务，为保护当地绿地出力。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。表示某团体的成员，用a member of。

ex.en: I feel pressure to answer work messages immediately.
ex.zh: 我觉得自己必须立即回复工作消息，这让我有压力。

ex.en: Employers should avoid putting excessive pressure on staff, as this can damage both health and productivity.
ex.zh: 雇主应避免给员工施加过大压力，因为这既可能损害健康，也可能降低生产力。

col: pressure someone into doing something｜迫使某人做某事
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。under pressure表示承压；动词常接into doing。

ex.en: Several bakeries compete for customers on our street.
ex.zh: 我们街上的几家面包店都在争取顾客。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

ex.en: What is your opinion of our new kitchen?
ex.zh: 你觉得我们的新厨房怎么样？

ex.en: In my opinion, public transport should be affordable enough to encourage people to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 在我看来，公共交通的价格应足够实惠，从而鼓励人们不开私家车出门。

col: a difference of opinion｜意见分歧
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。

senses.zh: 推，决心；大规模攻势；矢志的追求
推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫；按；说服

ex.en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
ex.zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？

ex.en: Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在学业上进步，而不是迫使他们不断与同学竞争。

col: push someone to do something｜敦促某人做某事
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。push表示推，pull表示拉；push for意为力争。

ex.en: Baking good bread takes patience and a little skill.
ex.zh: 烤出好面包需要耐心和一点技巧。

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills that help young people manage money and communicate effectively.
ex.zh: 学校应教授实用技能，帮助年轻人管理金钱并进行有效沟通。

col: develop a skill｜培养一项技能
skill in doing something｜做某事的技巧
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。

senses.zh: 典型的；特有的；象征性的

ex.en: A typical weekday starts with breakfast and a walk.
ex.zh: 平常的工作日都是从吃早餐和散步开始的。

ex.en: Long commuting times are typical of large cities where housing near employment centres is expensive.
ex.zh: 在就业中心附近住房昂贵的大城市，通勤时间长是常见现象。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。用typical of表示具有某人或某物的典型特征。

ex.en: We play football in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Local football clubs can strengthen community relationships by bringing together people from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方足球俱乐部能够聚集不同社会背景的人，从而增进社区联系。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。英式football指足球；美式通常指美式橄榄球。
📘 8B Unit 4

senses.zh: 快的；迅速的，敏捷的；灵敏的

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
ex.zh: 她反应敏捷，及时接住了差点掉落的玻璃杯。

ex.en: A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.
ex.zh: 对水污染报告作出迅速回应，可以防止附近生态系统遭受严重破坏。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。正式表达中用副词quickly修饰动作。

ex.en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是继续沿着海滩走。

ex.en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

senses.zh: 相比，匹敌；比较，区别；比拟（常与to连用）

ex.en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
ex.zh: 我们比较了几个背包，最后选了最轻的那个。

ex.en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
ex.zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。

col: compare A with B｜将A与B比较
compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B
compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

ex.en: It seems crazy to wear sandals in this snow.
ex.zh: 下着这样的雪还穿凉鞋，实在很不明智。

ex.en: Although some people consider car-free cities a crazy idea, such policies could significantly improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 尽管一些人认为无车城市是个荒唐的想法，这类政策却可能显著改善城市空气质量。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。偏口语；crazy about表示着迷，不宜用来称呼精神疾病患者。

senses.zh: 发展；开发；发育；住宅小区（专指由同一开发商开发的）； 显影

ex.en: Regular play supports a young child's development in many ways.
ex.zh: 经常玩耍能从多方面促进幼儿的成长。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can support economic development while reducing traffic congestion in growing cities.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通既能支持经济发展，也能缓解扩张中的城市的交通拥堵。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。泛指发展通常不可数；表示新进展时可数。

ex.en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
ex.zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

ex.en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
ex.zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。

ex.en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 对科技行业的一些员工来说，居家办公已成为常规安排。

col: the usual routine｜惯常的生活规律
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。

senses.zh: 在……看来；在某人看来；就某人看来

tip: 📘 8B Unit 4

senses.zh: 或许；（表示不确定）也许；（用于粗略的估计）或许；（表示勉强同意或其实不赞成）也许；可能

ex.en: Perhaps we should take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 也许我们该带把伞，那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Perhaps governments could encourage healthier diets by making fresh produce more affordable for low-income households.
ex.zh: 政府或许可以让低收入家庭更买得起新鲜农产品，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

col: perhaps the best｜或许是最好的
perhaps we could｜或许我们可以
tip: 📘 8B Unit 4。perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。
📘 8B Unit 5

ex.en: My alarm rang before sunrise, waking the whole family.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟在日出前响了，把全家人都吵醒了。

ex.en: Every school should test its fire alarm regularly to ensure that pupils receive an immediate warning.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应定期测试火灾警报器，确保学生能立即收到警报。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。警报响起用go off，不是go on。
📘 8B Unit 5

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
ex.zh: 大家都在餐桌旁坐好后，我们开始吃晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授网络安全知识，让孩子养成负责任地使用互联网的习惯。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。过去式began，过去分词begun；后接不定式或动名词。

ex.en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
ex.zh: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。

ex.en: Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
ex.zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。表示下大雨用rain heavily，不用rain strongly。

ex.en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
ex.zh: 我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。

ex.en: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
ex.zh: 当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。
📘 8B Unit 5

senses.zh: 拿起电话；接电话；接起电话

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5

ex.en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。

ex.en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
ex.zh: 在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

senses.zh: 起风暴；横冲直撞；狂怒咆哮

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。

col: a storm of protest｜抗议浪潮
storm out of the room｜怒气冲冲地走出房间
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

senses.zh: 缠绕；上发条；使弯曲；吹号角；绕住或缠住某人

ex.en: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat away.
ex.zh: 突然一阵风把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Investing in wind power can help countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels and lower carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 投资风能可以帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低碳排放。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。风读/wɪnd/；缠绕读/waɪnd/，过去式wound。

senses.zh: 光；光线；灯；打火机；领悟；浅色；天窗
轻的；浅色的；明亮的；轻松的；容易的；清淡的

ex.en: Warm light came through the curtains into our bedroom.
ex.zh: 温暖的光线透过窗帘照进了我们的卧室。

ex.en: Access to natural light in classrooms may improve students' concentration and reduce electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 让自然光进入教室可能有助于提高学生的专注力，并减少用电量。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。光线通常不可数；一盏灯用a light；动词过去式常用lit。

ex.en: I finished my report before lunch and emailed it.
ex.zh: 我午饭前写完了报告，并通过电子邮件发了出去。

ex.en: The report suggests that improved access to green spaces can benefit residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 这份报告指出，让居民更方便地使用绿地有益于他们的身心健康。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

ex.en: There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
ex.zh: 湖边有一处安静的野餐区。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。

col: an area of research｜研究领域
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。

ex.en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
ex.zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。

ex.en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
ex.zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。

col: a piece of wood｜一块木头
walk in the woods｜在树林中散步
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

ex.en: Please open the window and let some fresh air in.
ex.zh: 请打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Installing larger windows can reduce the need for artificial lighting in homes during daylight hours.
ex.zh: 安装更大的窗户可以减少住宅在白天对人工照明的需求。

col: a window of opportunity｜机会之窗
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。电脑窗口也叫window；机会之窗强调时机有限。

ex.en: She used a flashlight to look under the bed.
ex.zh: 她用手电筒照着查看床底。

ex.en: Households should keep a flashlight readily available to improve safety during unexpected power cuts.
ex.zh: 家庭应将手电筒放在随手可取的地方，以提高突发停电时的安全性。

col: turn on a flashlight｜打开手电筒
shine a flashlight｜用手电筒照射
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。手电筒的美式说法；英式通常用torch。

senses.zh: 使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争
比赛；匹配；相配，相称；相比
比赛，竞赛；匹配；对手；火柴

ex.en: We watched a football match at the local park.
ex.zh: 我们在附近的公园看了一场足球比赛。

ex.en: Training programmes should match the skills taught in colleges with the needs of local employers.
ex.zh: 培训项目应使院校教授的技能与当地雇主的需求相匹配。

col: match A with B｜将A与B匹配
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。match强调搭配协调；fit常指尺寸合适。

senses.zh: 拍子；敲击；有规律的一连串敲打
筋疲力尽的；疲惫不堪的
打；打败；拍打；有节奏地舒张与收缩

ex.en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋赢了我。

ex.en: Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.
ex.zh: 运动员需要持续训练和心理支持，才能在国际赛事中击败最强劲的对手。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。过去式 beat，过去分词 beaten；赢比赛用 win。

ex.en: Our team is playing against the neighbours this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们队要和邻居们比赛。

ex.en: Some residents are against airport expansion because they fear increased noise and damage to nearby habitats.
ex.zh: 一些居民反对机场扩建，因为他们担心噪声增加以及附近栖息地遭到破坏。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
📘 8B Unit 5

ex.en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
ex.zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。

ex.en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。
📘 8B Unit 5
📘 8B Unit 5

ex.en: Warm air rises above the heater beside my desk.
ex.zh: 我书桌旁的暖气上方，热空气向上升腾。

ex.en: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
ex.zh: 住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。

col: a rise in prices｜物价上涨
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

senses.zh: 堕落的；落下来的；陷落的

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5

senses.zh: 相距；与众不同地；分离着

ex.en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
ex.zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。

ex.en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
ex.zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。
📘 8B Unit 5

senses.zh: 冰冷的；冷淡的；结满冰的

ex.en: We walked slowly along the icy path this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，我们沿着结冰的小路慢慢走。

ex.en: Local authorities should treat icy roads promptly to reduce accidents and maintain reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 地方政府应及时处理结冰路面，以减少事故并保障公共交通可靠运行。

col: an icy stare｜冷冰冰的凝视
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。icy既可指覆冰或极冷，也可形容态度冷漠。

senses.zh: 实现；认识到；了解；将某物卖得，把(证券等)变成现钱；变卖

ex.en: I realized I had left my keys at home.
ex.zh: 我意识到自己把钥匙落在家里了。

ex.en: Affordable training can help young people realize their potential and gain access to more rewarding careers.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训能帮助年轻人发挥潜力，获得更有发展前景的工作。

col: realize your potential｜发挥你的潜力
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。英式也拼作realise；意识到某事可接that从句。
📘 8B Unit 5
📘 8B Unit 5

senses.zh: 学生； 瞳孔；未成年人

ex.en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
ex.zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。

ex.en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

ex.en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
ex.zh: 在雨中走过之后，我的鞋全湿透了。

ex.en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。

ex.en: I was shocked to find water flooding the kitchen.
ex.zh: 发现厨房里到处是水，我惊呆了。

ex.en: Residents were shocked by the sudden closure of the only hospital serving their rural community.
ex.zh: 当地居民对唯一服务于他们乡村社区的医院突然关闭感到震惊。

col: shocked by the news｜被消息震惊
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。shocked形容人的感受；shocking形容令人震惊的事物。

senses.zh: 沉默；寂静；缄默；不谈；无声状态
使沉默；使安静；压制；消除噪音

ex.en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
ex.zh: 外面下着雪，我们静静地坐着。

ex.en: Extended periods of silence in classrooms can give students valuable time to reflect on difficult questions.
ex.zh: 课堂上较长的安静时段可以给学生宝贵的时间来思考难题。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。in silence意为默默地；silent是形容词。

senses.zh: 沉默地；静静地；沉默不语

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5

ex.en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
ex.zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。

ex.en: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。
📘 8B Unit 5
📘 8B Unit 5

senses.zh: 过时；注明日期；始于（某一历史时期）

ex.en: Have you chosen a date for the picnic?
ex.zh: 你选好野餐的日期了吗？

ex.en: Researchers used wooden tools found nearby to date the remains of this ancient village.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用附近发现的木制工具确定这座古村落遗迹的年代。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。date back to表示始于某时期，不用被动语态。

ex.en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
ex.zh: 我们爬上塔，看着船只驶过海湾。

ex.en: The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.
ex.zh: 这座历史悠久的塔全年吸引着游客，为附近的商店和餐馆带来可观收入。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。作动词常接over或above，表示远高于周围事物。

ex.en: Please tell me the truth about the broken cup.
ex.zh: 请告诉我杯子打碎的真相。

ex.en: Journalists should seek the truth rather than publish stories that simply attract public attention.
ex.zh: 记者应当寻求真相，而不是发表仅仅吸引公众注意的报道。

col: the truth about something｜关于某事的真相
tip: 📘 8B Unit 5。说实话用tell the truth，通常不能省略the。

senses.zh: 马丁·路德·金；金恩博士；马丁路德金恩

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5
📘 8B Unit 5

senses.zh: 世贸中心；纽约世界贸易中心；世贸大厦

tip: 📘 8B Unit 5

senses.zh: 射击，射中；拍摄；发芽；使爆炸；给…注射

ex.en: She learned to shoot arrows at a local club.
ex.zh: 她在当地一家俱乐部学会了射箭。

ex.en: Film crews often shoot documentaries in remote locations to highlight the effects of climate change.
ex.zh: 摄制组常在偏远地区拍摄纪录片，以突出气候变化的影响。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。过去式和过去分词均为shot；shoot at指朝……射击。

ex.en: She picked up a smooth stone beside the lake.
ex.zh: 她在湖边捡起了一块光滑的石头。

ex.en: Buildings constructed from local stone can preserve regional character and reduce the environmental costs of transporting materials.
ex.zh: 使用当地石料建造的建筑可以保留地域特色，并降低运输建材带来的环境成本。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。

senses.zh: 疲软的；虚弱的；无力的；不牢固的

ex.en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
ex.zh: 我觉得浑身无力，没法把买来的东西提上楼。

ex.en: Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.
ex.zh: 依据薄弱证据制定的政策可能无法解决失业的根本原因。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

senses.en: The supreme being worshipped in religions believing in one god.

ex.en: My grandmother thanks God before each meal at home.
ex.zh: 我祖母在家每次用餐前都会感谢上帝。

ex.en: Belief in God can influence people's values, charitable activities, and responses to difficult circumstances.
ex.zh: 对上帝的信仰可能影响人们的价值观、慈善活动及应对困境的方式。

col: faith in God｜对上帝的信仰
tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。指唯一的神用God，通常不加冠词；泛指神用god。

ex.en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
ex.zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。

ex.en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
ex.zh: 学校应定期提醒学生，在使用在线学习平台时保护个人信息。

col: remind someone to do something｜提醒某人做某事
remind someone of something｜使某人想起某事
tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

senses.zh: 比特（二进位制信息单位）；少量；马嚼子；辅币；老一套；一点，一块
咬（bite的过去式和过去分词）

ex.en: There is a bit of cake left for you.
ex.zh: 还给你留了一点蛋糕。

ex.en: Even a small bit of practical experience can help students understand difficult scientific concepts.
ex.zh: 即使只有少量实践经验，也能帮助学生理解困难的科学概念。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。
📘 8B Unit 6

senses.zh: 愚蠢的；不明事理的；没头脑的

ex.en: It was silly to leave my umbrella at home.
ex.zh: 把伞留在家里真是不明智。

ex.en: Teachers should avoid calling any question silly, as this may discourage students from participating in class.
ex.zh: 教师应避免说任何问题愚蠢，因为这可能打击学生参与课堂的积极性。

tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。
📘 8B Unit 6

ex.en: A shiny object was lying beneath the sofa.
ex.zh: 沙发下面有个闪闪发亮的东西。

ex.en: Many residents object to the proposed airport expansion because it could increase noise pollution.
ex.zh: 许多居民反对拟议中的机场扩建，因为这可能加剧噪声污染。

col: object to a proposal｜反对一项提议
the object of the exercise｜这项活动的目的
tip: 📘 8B Unit 6。名词重音在前，动词在后；object to后接名词或动名词。
